record.name: Mauritius
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The AI strategy and FAIR Guidelines were launched on 9 April 2026; the strategy also plans regulatory sandboxes and sectoral AI Centres of Excellence with testing and evaluation facilities.

related_bodies.name: AI Unit, Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation
related_bodies.role: It leads the national AI strategy; it is a policy unit, and no model evaluation mandate was found.

The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
